question: Xi Jinping out before 2027?
description:
This market will resolve to "Yes" if China's General Secretary of the Communist Party, Xi Jinping, is removed from power for any length of time between July 3, 2025, and December 31, 2026, 11:59 PM ET. Otherwise, this market will resolve to "No".

CCP General Secretary Xi Jinping will be considered removed from power if he announces his resignation from his role as General Secretary, or is otherwise dismissed, detained, disqualified, or otherwise loses his position or is prevented from fulfilling his duties as General Secretary within this market's timeframe.

The primary resolution source for this market will be a consensus of credible reporting.

eventMetadata.context_description: Xi Jinping's consolidated authority within the Chinese Communist Party, including his removal of term limits and dominance over the Politburo, military leadership, and security apparatus, underpins the 95.5% trader consensus against removal before 2027. Recent analyses through mid-2026 show no credible signs of internal challenges or succession moves at the upcoming 21st Party Congress, with expectations centered on a fourth term rather than any transition. Purges in the People's Liberation Army reflect his ongoing control rather than vulnerability. While trader pricing reflects this structural stability and absence of organized opposition, low-probability shifts could still arise from acute health developments, severe economic downturns prompting elite realignment, or unforeseen leadership disputes before the December 2026 resolution window.
